scope.description: The complete Arabic Creed, a source-defined spoken profession beginning after the red Creed rubric at part II p. 85 and ending with Amen at II p. 87 before the following red rubric. Every black Arabic body word in this expression is represented, with declared unvocalized reading normalization. This constituent excludes the parallel Coptic expression, rubrics, page furniture and all other book divisions; it is not the complete ordinary, missal or bilingual page.
omitted_book_divisions: The parallel Coptic Creed expression on the same pages
The red rubric introducing the Creed and the red rubric following Amen
All other ordinary prayers, rubrics, three anaphoras, incense offices and appendices
Page numbers, ornament, line wrapping, catchwords and typographic vocalization as declared in the source transformation

sources.transformation: Read the 676 exact JPEG resources from the parent ZIP in sequence.json order and embed each complete byte stream unchanged in a PDF DCTDecode image object. One image fills each PDF page; page dimensions in points equal pixel dimensions. No cropping, reordering, resampling, color conversion, OCR or text alteration. The exact images and manifest remain in the parent ZIP. This is a lossless facsimile derivative, not a Bonn-issued PDF.

sources.rights_basis: Faithful bounded transcription of the identified 1736 historical Arabic text, public domain in the United States by its publication date. ULB Bonn marks the retained parent digitization Public Domain Mark 1.0. No new translation or critical reconstruction. This source text is excluded from Triptych’s CC BY 4.0 grant.
sources.transformation: Read the original images embedded unchanged in parent PDF SHA-256 add039d0fa12b9379035c2820e10ff6df042dc49651628a7dc7f3e9f6b5f375f. Part II printed pp. 85–87, right Arabic column: first black Creed line after the red Creed rubric on p. 85 through Amen on p. 87, before the following long red rubric; PDF artifact pages 378–380 (one-based). Join source line wraps and ten typographic paragraphs into one reading line; omit decorative endpoint rosettes, vowel/accent signs, typographic elongation and discretionary spacing. Do not insert punctuation or modern hamzas. Preserve historical words and spellings, including بالاه, الاه, نومن, وتانس, تالم, العذرى, بلاطس, الاحيا, انقضا and شى. Separate لا يرى as two lexical words. Source terminal yāʾ is historically undotted or not consistently distinguishable at the retained resolution: lexical Unicode ي/ى choices are an explicit reading normalization, not a claim to reproduce printed dotting. Omit the catchwords نحن at the foot of II.85 and مع at the foot of II.86, retaining each only in its following body line. Encode one NFC UTF-8 line with one final LF. units.text: نومن بالاه واحد اب ضابط الكل خالق السماء والارض ما يرى وما لا يرى نومن برب واحد يسوع المسيح ابن الله الوحيد المولود من الاب قبل كل الدهور نور من نور الاه حق من الاه حق مولود غير مخلوق مساوي الاب في الجوهر الذي به كان كل شى هذا الذي من اجلنا نحن البشر ومن اجل خلاصنا نزل من السماء وتجسد من الروح القدس ومن مريم العذرى وتانس وصلب عنا على عهد بلاطس البنطى تالم وقبر وقام من بين الاموات في اليوم الثالث كما في الكتب وصعد الى السموات وجلس عن يمين ابيه وايضا ياتي في مجده ليدين الاحيا والاموات الذي ليس لملكه انقضا ونومن بالروح القدس الرب المحيي المنبثق من الاب والابن نسجد له ونمجده مع الاب والابن الناطق في الانبياء وبكنيسة واحدة مقدسة جامعة رسولية ونعترف بمعمودية واحدة لمغفرة الخطايا وننتظر قيامة الاموات وحياة الدهر الاتي امين
